_comment: Single source for the renderer libraries embedded into every generated unit. Versions come from package.json/package-lock.json; scripts/copy_vendor.mjs copies the files from node_modules and prepends the license text. src/unit/assembler.py reads the same list. The CDN URLs are only used when a file is missing, and then pin the same version.

vegalite._license_note: The vega package ships no LICENSE file; vega.min.js bundles vega-canvas and the other vega-* modules, which carry the identical BSD-3-Clause notice of the same copyright holder.
